prompt.project_info: Create a friendly photorealistic classroom portrait of an approved adult woman standing beside a chalkboard.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long loose light-brown waves, calm soft smile, confident expression, and natural skin texture. She wears a modest light-blue collared blouse, tailored black skirt or trousers, and minimal jewelry, holding chalk naturally while facing camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level three-quarter-body portrait, subject beside a chalkboard, desks, bulletin boards, educational posters, and classroom architecture behind. Preserve existing handwritten equations and posters as environment typography without inventing extra copy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft fluorescent classroom lighting mixed with natural ambience, even clean tones, soft shadows, organized academic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone-style portrait, sharp subject, slightly softened classroom background, accurate hands and chalk, natural skin, subtle grain, 4:5 or 9:16 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a friendly photorealistic classroom portrait of an approved adult woman with long loose light-brown waves, natural skin texture, a calm soft smile, and confident expression. She stands beside a chalkboard holding chalk naturally and looks toward the camera. She wears a modest light-blue collared blouse, tailored black skirt or trousers, and minimal jewelry. Use an eye-level three-quarter-body composition with chalkboard equations, desks, bulletin boards, educational posters, and organized classroom architecture behind. Preserve existing board writing as environmental typography without inventing text. Use soft fluorescent classroom lighting with natural ambient fill, clean tones, soft shadows, sharp subject, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, altered equations, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face
